feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: British DJ named as one of six people killed in Krakow shooting
articles.summary: A British DJ has been identified as one of six people killed in a shooting in Krakow.

articles.title: Strike by consultant doctors in England paused
articles.summary: A strike by consultant doctors in England has been paused following meetings with the government, the British Medical Association (BMA) announced.

articles.title: Man Utd 'reach agreement in principle with Pochettino' as decision due on Carrick's future
articles.summary: Manchester United have reportedly reached an agreement in principle for Mauricio Pochettino to be their next head coach if Michael Carrick is sacked.

articles.title: Threatening emails sent to thousands of schools across UK, Ireland and Italy treated as hoaxes
articles.summary: Threatening emails sent to thousands of schools across the UK, Ireland and Italy are being treated as hoaxes.

articles.title: Four children among those in hospital after car collides with pedestrian
articles.summary: Four children were among those injured after a car collided with pedestrians in Glasgow.

articles.title: Police address 'violent incident' claim against Russell Brand made by Jemima Goldsmith
articles.summary: Police have addressed an alleged "violent incident" involving Russell Brand after claims made his then-girlfriend Jemima Goldsmith.

articles.title: Temperatures set to fall to -7C as first cold weather health alert of the winter issued
articles.summary: Temperatures in parts of the UK could fall to -7C this week, as health chiefs issue the first cold weather alert for the season.

articles.title: Trump's lawsuit against BBC can go ahead, judge rules
articles.summary: The BBC's attempt to have Donald Trump's $10bn (£7.5bn) defamation claim thrown out has been dismissed by a Florida court.

articles.title: US charges three men allegedly linked to RAF Fairford incident
articles.summary: Three men have been accused by US authorities of being Iran-supported operatives who plotted more than a dozen attacks, including an alleged terrorist plot near a UK military base where American aircraft were stationed.
